items.title: Stephen Miller replaces Susie Wiles as White House chief of staff
items.feedTitle: Stephen Miller replaces Susie Wiles as Trump's White House chief of staff after GOP's midterm defeat
items.summary: President Trump has promoted Stephen Miller, his longtime immigration hardliner, to White House chief of staff, replacing Susie Wiles, the first woman to hold the position. Miller, the architect of Trump's mass deportation policies, has been a close confidant since 2016. The move signals Trump's continued focus on immigration enforcement despite Democrats' midterm victory and voter rejection of mass deportation campaigns.

items.title: California voters reject billionaire wealth tax proposal
items.feedTitle: California rejects billionaire tax proposal in win for executives, Newsom
items.summary: Californians voted down a proposed wealth tax on billionaire residents, marking a major victory for tech and business executives who spent hundreds of millions opposing the measure. According to Decision Desk HQ projections, 54 percent voted against the proposal.

items.title: Two additional DOJ officials resign, including national security head
items.feedTitle: Two more DOJ officials resign, including head of national security division
items.summary: Two more Department of Justice officials have resigned, including the head of the national security division. This adds to departures of key officials since the midterm elections, as the Trump administration reshapes its leadership.

items.title: Kansas elects Democrat to U.S. Senate for first time since 1932
items.feedTitle: Sen.-elect Hamilton reflects on why Kansas voters chose a Democrat for U.S. Senate
items.summary: Voters in Kansas elected Rev. Adam Hamilton, a Democrat, to the U.S. Senate for the first time in nearly a century, defeating Republican incumbent Roger Marshall. Hamilton leads the largest United Methodist church in the country and campaigned on key Democratic priorities.

items.title: Anti-trans measures pass despite Democratic midterm gains
items.feedTitle: Anti-trans measures on youth sports, treatment pass despite blue wave
items.summary: Voters in four states approved ballot measures restricting transgender youth from sports and medical treatments, despite the broader Democratic wave in the midterm elections. The results show divisions within the Democratic base on social issues even as the party achieved significant electoral victories.

stlouis.title: St. Louis Cardinals promote Rob Cerfolio to General Manager
stlouis.feedTitle: St. Louis Cardinals promote from within, tap Cerfolio as GM
stlouis.summary: The St. Louis Cardinals have promoted Rob Cerfolio from within the organization to serve as the team's new General Manager. The promotion reflects the Cardinals' strategy of building continuity in their front office leadership.

stlouis.title: Ascension closes St. Louis County operation, cutting 51 jobs
stlouis.feedTitle: Ascension to cut 51 jobs as St. Louis County operation closes
stlouis.summary: Healthcare provider Ascension announced the closure of its St. Louis County operation, resulting in 51 job cuts. The move represents a significant reduction in Ascension's regional presence.

stlouis.title: St. Louis mayor headed to Africa on regional trade mission
stlouis.feedTitle: St. Louis mayor headed to Africa on regional trade mission
stlouis.summary: St. Louis Mayor Tishaura Jones is traveling to Africa for a regional trade mission aimed at strengthening economic ties and exploring business opportunities for the city.

items.title: Paraguay president impeached, detained after bank collapse crisis
items.feedTitle: Ousted Paraguay president under house arrest after banking crisis leaves 60% of country unable to access accounts
items.summary: Paraguay's President Santiago Peña was impeached and placed under house arrest minutes after Congress voted to pursue an impeachment trial, amid a severe banking crisis that has left 60% of the country unable to access their accounts. The Ueno bank collapse sparked the political upheaval. Pena's detention came as protesters demanded answers and a new president was sworn in.

items.title: US military carries out new targeted strike on Iran
items.feedTitle: US military carries out new targeted strike on Iran as Tehran's leaders weigh mediator's proposals
items.summary: The U.S. military has conducted a new targeted strike on Iran as Tehran's leadership weighs proposals from a mediator. The strike occurs amid escalating tensions and ongoing discussions about potential diplomatic resolution.

items.title: Thomas Markle, Meghan's father, charged in child abuse case
items.feedTitle: Thomas Markle, Meghan’s father, charged in Florida in connection to child sexual abuse material
items.summary: Thomas Markle, the father of Meghan, Duchess of Sussex, was arrested by federal agents in Florida and charged in connection with possession of child sexual abuse material, according to prosecutors. He was taken into custody near Tampa.

items.title: Pope Leo XIV begins South American tour after lung surgery
items.feedTitle: Pope Leo XIV arrives for South American tour after cancer surgery
items.summary: Pope Leo XIV has arrived in Uruguay to begin a 12-day tour of South America, just weeks after undergoing lung surgery. The pontiff is praised for Uruguay's clean energy transition and is calling for universal healthcare access.

items.title: Wave of bomb threats disrupts European flights and broadcasters
items.feedTitle: Further bomb threats disrupt at least another 18 flights across Europe
items.summary: A coordinated wave of bomb threats has disrupted at least 18 additional flights across Europe and affected media organizations in the UK and Ireland. No explosives have been found in searches of affected aircraft, which landed safely. The threats are believed to be part of an apparent coordinated campaign of disruption.

items.title: Sonia Gandhi says BJP caused 'great damage' to India's fabric
items.feedTitle: Sonia Gandhi interview: ‘Great damage done to the fabric of India by BJP’
items.summary: Former Congress president Sonia Gandhi, in a media interview, criticized the BJP government, claiming it has done 'great damage to the fabric of India' through its policies and governance. She spoke about her book and her deep connection to the country.

items.title: Delhi-NCR stricter pollution curbs imposed under GRAP-III
items.feedTitle: Stricter Pollution Curbs Under GRAP-III Imposed In Delhi-NCR Ahead Of Diwali
items.summary: Delhi and NCR regions have imposed stricter pollution control measures under GRAP-III (Graded Response Action Plan Stage 3) ahead of Diwali, as air quality indices touched dangerous levels. Vehicular emissions were flagged by the Supreme Court as a major pollution source.

items.title: Diwali 2026: Indians celebrate festival with lights and fireworks
items.feedTitle: Diwali 2026: Indians celebrate festival with lights and fireworks
items.summary: Indians across the country are celebrating Diwali, the festival of lights, with traditional illuminations, fireworks, and festivities. The celebration spans from border villages in Jammu to major cities like Delhi and Mumbai.

items.title: CBI files fraud case against Kishore Biyani, Future Retail
items.feedTitle: India probes Future Retail in alleged bank fraud case
items.summary: India's Central Bureau of Investigation (CBI) has filed a case against Kishore Biyani and Future Retail in connection with an alleged bank fraud involving approximately Rs 904 crore with State Bank of India. The case examines financial irregularities at the Big Bazaar parent company.

items.title: Gold price drop drives brisk Dhanteras jewellery sales
items.feedTitle: Jewellers report brisk Dhanteras sales as gold price drop lures buyers; volumes seen flat
items.summary: Jewellers reported strong sales during Dhanteras, the auspicious day for purchasing gold, as declining gold prices attracted more buyers. However, overall volumes are expected to remain flat compared to previous years despite the price incentive.

immigration.title: Stephen Miller elevation raises concerns for legal immigrants
immigration.feedTitle: Stephen Miller Becomes White House Chief of Staff: What It Means for Legal Immigrants
immigration.summary: Legal immigration advocates are concerned about Stephen Miller's promotion to White House chief of staff, given his role as architect of Trump's hardline immigration policies. Miller's appointment signals likely increased scrutiny and restrictions on legal immigration pathways including H-1B visas and employment-based green cards.

immigration.title: US set for largest mass visa revocation in history
immigration.feedTitle: US set for largest mass visa revocation in history targeting up to 200,000 foreigners, officials say
immigration.summary: The U.S. State Department has revoked more than 175,000 visas, and officials say the country is set for the largest mass visa revocation in history, potentially targeting up to 200,000 foreigners. The scope and criteria for revocation remain under review.

immigration.title: DHS ends automatic extension of employment authorization documents
immigration.feedTitle: Removal of Automatic Extensions for Certain Employment Authorization Documents
immigration.summary: The Department of Homeland Security published an interim final rule (finalized and in effect as of October 30, 2025) ending the automatic extension of employment authorization documents (EADs/Forms I-766) for aliens who have timely filed applications to renew. This change affects workers seeking to extend their stay.

items.title: Wall Street loses $2.5 trillion in historic tech stock rout
items.feedTitle: Wall Street Gets $2.5 Trillion AI Reality Check With Historic Rout of Tech Stocks
items.summary: U.S. tech stocks experienced a historic selloff this week, with approximately $2.5 trillion in market value wiped out. The rout was triggered by concerns over Democrats' midterm victory and potential AI regulation, with major companies like Nvidia, Apple, and Tesla leading losses. It marked one of the worst weeks for the Nasdaq in recent years.

items.title: Indian markets extend winning streak amid global tech rout
items.feedTitle: Sensex Reclaims 80,000 After Eight Months, Nifty Crosses 24,700 Despite Global Sell-Off
items.summary: Indian stock markets defied the global technology selloff, with Sensex and Nifty recording their best weekly performance in six years. Sensex surged over 1,700 points to cross 81,000, while Nifty reclaimed 25,000, as foreign fund inflows and Dhanteras-driven buying supported equities.

items.title: U.S. labor market adds 165,000 jobs in October, exceeds expectations
items.feedTitle: US labor market regains ground as job growth surges, unemployment rate falls to 4.1%
items.summary: The U.S. economy added 165,000 jobs in October, surpassing forecasts and providing signs of labor market resilience. Job gains for August and September were revised upward by a combined 84,000 jobs, improving the outlook for the last three months. The unemployment rate fell to 4.1%.

items.title: Elon Musk announces Tesla will wind down Cybertruck production
items.feedTitle: Elon Musk Is Killing the Cybertruck. What It Means for Tesla Stock.
items.summary: Tesla CEO Elon Musk announced the company will end Cybertruck production at its Austin Gigafactory to redirect resources toward manufacturing the Cybercab, an autonomous taxi without a driver. The move marks the end of the troubled pickup truck effort after years of poor sales.

cards.title: Constraints fuel iteration
cards.insight: The most creative breakthroughs often emerge when resources, time, or rules are tightest. A budget limit forces prioritization; a deadline compresses thinking. Constraints eliminate infinite options and force deeper engagement with core problems.
cards.takeaway: When starting a project, deliberately set one binding constraint—time, budget, or scope—before brainstorming, rather than removing friction.

cards.title: Cross-domain collision
cards.insight: Novel ideas rarely emerge within a single domain. They surface when concepts from unrelated fields collide—a biologist's insight borrowed into design, a musician's principle applied to software. Creativity feeds on friction between unlike things.
cards.takeaway: Read or study in a field adjacent to your work; actively seek ideas from domains that feel foreign, and ask how one principle might reshape another.

cards.title: Failure as data, not judgment
cards.insight: Creative work demands iteration, which means most attempts fail. But reframing failure as feedback—not as proof of incompetence—sustains the willingness to try. Each failed experiment narrows the search space and clarifies what works.
cards.takeaway: Document what failed and why; treat each iteration as an experiment with results, not a judgment on the creator or the idea's ultimate potential.

cards.title: Boredom precedes breakthrough
cards.insight: The urge to create often arrives after sustained exposure to a problem or medium. Boredom with the status quo, or frustration with existing solutions, is the spark. Creative energy builds when you sit long enough with an unsolved gap.
cards.takeaway: Spend time immersed in a problem without rushing to solve it; let boredom and curiosity accumulate before pushing toward answers.

ai.title: OpenAI completes $11 billion funding round at $1.25 trillion valuation
ai.feedTitle: OpenAI gets $11 billion funding at $1.25 trillion valuation, source says
ai.summary: OpenAI has closed an $11 billion funding round at a $1.25 trillion valuation, strengthening its position as the leading AI lab. The funding comes as the company faces competitive pressure from Anthropic and amid broader concerns over AI regulation following Democrats' midterm victories.

ai.title: Anthropic targets $1.5 trillion IPO amid market turbulence
ai.feedTitle: Anthropic to press ahead with IPO targeting $1.5tn valuation
ai.summary: Anthropic is proceeding with its IPO despite market volatility following the tech selloff, targeting a $1.5 trillion valuation. However, investors are bracing for lower valuation expectations as concerns mount over AI regulation and the broader AI spending trajectory.
